purpose: Prove the open Agent-neutral demand-driven human-Agent collaboration quality harness through goal-level natural-task dogfooding, dynamic capability discovery and lifecycle arbitration, an accepted methodology and open quality-conformance profile, and thin cross-host reference adapters that reuse sufficient external protocol, runtime, identity, audit, provenance, and evaluation layers.

increments.observedProblem: Two natural Codex compactions produced no user-managed recovery, but the task-specific validation path failed twice because it guessed volatile host record and turn semantics before observing the eligible event; the second validator imposed an original-turn restriction absent from the immutable pre-registration, turning real product work into a repeated verifier-calibration loop.
increments.hypothesis: Freezing criterion-defined measurement fields, source-capture boundaries, floors, falsifiers, and claim limits before measured execution while requiring the exact task-bound code validator only before outcome promotion will preserve zero-trust acceptance without guessing future host serialization or adding post-hoc rules.
increments.falsifier: A verified outcome can pass without an exact task-bound criterion and increment validator; a validator may weaken or add measurement rules after observing results without rejection; a generic receipt validator returns; or the repair requires a new runtime, audit format, receipt ecosystem, user round trip, or outcome claim.
increments.stopCondition: Stop when the active gate distinguishes immutable pre-execution measurement registration from pre-promotion code validation, verified outcomes still require exact task-bound validators and completed causal bindings, the current tree has no generic or task-specific outcome validator, public architecture and operations describe the same boundary, O1-O5 remain false, deterministic verification passes, residue is absent, and the repair is committed and pushed before leaving the current graph.

deliverables: one lean pre-execution measurement and pre-promotion validation boundary grounded in the stopped continuity attempt and fixed evaluation sources
